instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-performance Spanish Mobile Web App (PWA) with React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Framer Motion, and Sonner toasts.
Implement full mobile-first app layout with top header status, glassmorphic floating bottom navigation bar, and tab screens.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='plan-with-ai-btn').
DO NOT use raw transparent backgrounds on sticky elements. Use backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/90 or solid cards with 1px border border-slate-800.
Support full Spanish UI copy throughout all screens and dialogs.
Implement real client-side state with localStorage persistence or React Query/Context for habits, routines, calendar feeds, scheduled slots, completed habits, and streaks.
Include a prominent 'Planificar con IA' trigger button with animated AI scheduling solver, conflict breakdown, and travel buffer calculation (e.g. 15 min ida + 15 min vuelta).

layout_and_navigation.device_frame: Mobile viewport container optimized for PWA with max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen border-x border-slate-800 shadow-2xl bg-[#0D1117] relative flex flex-col pb-24
layout_and_navigation.top_header: Sticky top-0 z-40 bg-[#0D1117]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#30363D] px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
layout_and_navigation.bottom_tab_bar: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 max-w-md mx-auto bg-[#161B22]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#30363D] px-3 py-2 flex justify-around items-center text-xs font-medium

hoy_view.title: Agenda de Hoy
features: Header showing current date in Spanish, streak indicator chip, and quick 'Planificar con IA' hero button.
Timeline list of today's items: Fixed Routines (Trabajo, Clases) + AI Scheduled Habit Sessions + Travel Time padding slots.
Each habit card features: priority badge, duration, travel time tag (e.g. '+15m ida/vuelta'), time window, and quick action buttons: 'Completada' (Done) & 'Posponer' (Postpone & Replan with AI).
AI Replan Drawer/Modal when postponing: shows updated optimal slot calculation.

calendario_view.title: Vista Semanal & iCal
features: Interactive day/week schedule grid showing hour blocks (07:00 to 23:00).
Color coding: Blue for Fixed Routines / iCal imports, Emerald green for AI-scheduled habit sessions, Orange for Travel time buffers.
Toggle view between Day Timeline and Week Grid.
Imported iCal status banner showing connected calendar (e.g. Google Calendar / iCal Feed sync active).

habitos_view.title: Gestión de Hábitos y Rutinas
features: Prioritized list of habits with drag/drop or priority rank controls (Alta, Media, Baja).
Comprehensive Create/Edit Habit Modal with advanced fields:
- Nombre de la tarea/hábito (e.g. Ir al Gimnasio, Estudiar Inglés, Leer)
- Frecuencia semanal (e.g. 3 días por semana)
- Duración por sesión (e.g. 90 minutos)
- Tiempo de desplazamiento ida y vuelta (e.g. 15 min ida / 15 min vuelta)
- Restricciones horarias prohibidas (e.g. No de 16:30 a 19:30)
- Días prohibidos (e.g. Sin fines de semana)
- Horarios preferidos (e.g. Mañanas / Tardes / Noches)
- Prioridad (1 a 5)
Section for Rutinas Fijas Inamovibles (Trabajo, Universidad, Clases de Alemán) with manual block creator.

ai_planner_modal.title: Asistente AI de Planificación (Planificar con IA)
features: Triggers algorithmic auto-scheduling that searches free gaps in user's calendar.
Animates AI optimization steps: 'Analizando rutinas fijas...', 'Calculando desplazamientos...', 'Evitando franjas saturadas...', 'Optimizando energía y descanso...'.
Displays AI rationale cards explaining WHY a slot was chosen (e.g. 'Gym programado el Martes a las 08:00 porque de 16:30 a 19:30 indicaste mucha afluencia').
One-click 'Confirmar y Aplicar al Calendario' button.

progreso_view.title: Progreso, Rachas y Logros
features: Weekly habit completion percentage radial chart / progress bar.
Streak metrics per habit (e.g. 'Gimnasio: 🔥 4 semanas consecutivas').
Logros desbloqueados (Badges for overcoming procrastination, e.g. 'Vencedor del Aplazamiento', 'Semana Redonda').
History log of postponed vs completed habits.

ajustes_view.title: Integración y Ajustes
features: Calendar iCal / Webcal Integration:
- Field to paste external iCal URL (Google Calendar / Outlook / iCal)
- WebCal export URL feed generator link to subscribe from iPhone Calendar / Google Calendar app
User schedule parameters: Horario de Despertar (e.g. 07:00), Horario de Sueño (e.g. 23:00), Buffer de descanso entre tareas (e.g. 15 min).

micro_interactions.hover_states: All buttons scale 1.02x with shadow glow and border brightness shift.
micro_interactions.button_active: Scale 0.97x on active tap with haptic tactile response feel.
micro_interactions.toast_notifications: Sonner toasts in Spanish for 'Hábito completado', 'Replanificado con éxito', 'Calendario iCal sincronizado'.
micro_interactions.streak_animation: Animated flame badge with pulse glow on completion.

accessibility_and_testids.contrast: APCA high contrast dark mode text (#F0F6FC on #161B22), minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
